assertions.name: no_structural_N_below_1000ppm
assertions.source: No combination of (m_e, q₀, Vol, ℏ, [n]_q) gives m_π within 1000 ppm

description: SDP + exhaustive-scan validation that m_π cannot be derived from (m_e, q₀). Tests 22 structural normalizations N against m_π = m_e · N · tr_M(π). NONE achieves < 1000 ppm. Combined with Vol(Hopf) = 0 (topological), confirms m_π as genuinely independent calibration input (CAL-3).
